brief: NSE and BSE are shut today for Guru Nanak Jayanti, so there is no Indian cash trading, while global markets stay buoyant after Nvidia's surge and gold extended gains. Several Indian company items are in focus, including Gland Pharma's USFDA clearance and South Indian Bank's RBI nod for an SBI Mutual Fund stake.
